g.text: No on-carrier lithium protection or duplicate charger. Identify and insulate the external protection board.

g.desc: No on-carrier lithium protection or duplicate charger. Identify and insulate the external protection board.

g.text: J1/J2/J3 and U1 footprints are intentionally unassigned pending exact parts and mechanical checks.

g.desc: J1/J2/J3 and U1 footprints are intentionally unassigned pending exact parts and mechanical checks.

g.text: Confirm actual display controller, cable ESD requirements, enclosure clearances and charging access.

g.desc: Confirm actual display controller, cable ESD requirements, enclosure clearances and charging access.

g.text: Before field use: polarity/continuity, ADC calibration, rail-off leakage, USB charging and 24-hour bench soak.

g.desc: Before field use: polarity/continuity, ADC calibration, rail-off leakage, USB charging and 24-hour bench soak.

g.text: VBUS intentionally NC. USB-C on XIAO is the only charger.

g.desc: VBUS intentionally NC. USB-C on XIAO is the only charger.

g.text: BAT+/-: short strain-relieved underside wires for prototype.

g.desc: BAT+/-: short strain-relieved underside wires for prototype.

g.text: Module footprint and antenna keepout must be verified before layout.

g.desc: Module footprint and antenna keepout must be verified before layout.

g.text: PROTOTYPE CAPTURE - NOT A FABRICATION RELEASE

g.desc: PROTOTYPE CAPTURE - NOT A FABRICATION RELEASE

g.text: C1 at U1. XIAO has no onboard A0 divider.

g.desc: C1 at U1. XIAO has no onboard A0 divider.

g.text: LOW = on. R1 holds Q1 off at reset. Q1: G=1, S=2, D=3.

g.desc: LOW = on. R1 holds Q1 off at reset. Q1: G=1, S=2, D=3.

g.text: Source is the lower pin here (3V3); drain is 3V3_SW.

g.desc: Source is the lower pin here (3V3); drain is 3V3_SW.

g.text: Firmware must not drive an unpowered peripheral high.

g.desc: Firmware must not drive an unpowered peripheral high.

g.text: J2 keyed part TBD. C4 at U1; C5 at J2.

g.desc: J2 keyed part TBD. C4 at U1; C5 at J2.

g.text: J3 odd/even pinout from WeAct drawing; cable orientation TBD.

g.desc: J3 odd/even pinout from WeAct drawing; cable orientation TBD.

g.text: JP1: fitted removable shunt. All battery loads are downstream.

g.desc: JP1: fitted removable shunt. All battery loads are downstream.

g.text: PWR_FLAG declares the external pack supply; it is not a component.

g.desc: PWR_FLAG declares the external pack supply; it is not a component.

g.text: External 1S protection PCB stays with the cell.

g.desc: External 1S protection PCB stays with the cell.

g.text: Cell + / - to B+ / B-. P+ to J1.1; P- to J1.2.

g.desc: Cell + / - to B+ / B-. P+ to J1.1; P- to J1.2.

g.text: Do not join B- to system GND. Confirm common-port charging.

g.desc: Do not join B- to system GND. Confirm common-port charging.
